name: 1,2'-Oxydipropanol dimethyl ether
description: 1,2'-Oxydipropanol dimethyl ether (CAS 89399-28-0 ), also known commercially as 1-methoxy-2-(2-methoxypropoxy)propane, is a glycol ether solvent used across coatings, cleaning, and printing applications. It functions as a solvent and carrier, dissolving a broad range of resins and active ingredients while offering controlled evaporation suited to industrial formulation work. In coatings and adhesives, it supports resin dissolution and film formation in solvent-borne systems where balanced evaporation rate is critical to surface quality. Industrial and institutional cleaning formulations use it as a degreasing solvent capable of cutting through oils and residues on hard surfaces. In printing inks and packaging applications, it acts as a carrier solvent that helps control viscosity and substrate wetting during high-speed print runs. Sealant and elastomer compounders also incorporate it where a mid-boiling glycol ether ether is needed to aid dispersion and processing. Supplied as a clear liquid in standard bulk and intermediate packaging formats including drums and IBCs. Technical grade is the primary commercial offering for industrial solvent applications. Purity specifications and lot documentation are typically available to support formulation QA and regulatory compliance requirements.
